# Comly

> Comly is an AI visibility audit platform for SaaS brands. It measures how often and how prominently a brand appears in responses generated by large language models (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity), tracks competitor rankings, and surfaces actionable fixes to improve AI visibility.

Comly combines multi-model auditing, prompt-level response analysis, competitor benchmarking, Reddit and Quora engagement tooling, and content optimisation recommendations in a single dashboard.

## Core Product

- [Home](https://trycomly.com): Landing page — overview of AI visibility auditing, pricing, and live demo.
- [Run Audit](https://trycomly.com/audit): Submit a website URL to trigger a full AI visibility audit across 25 prompts and 4 AI models.
- [Live Demo](https://trycomly.com/demo): Interactive demo dashboard using Notion as a sample brand.

## Dashboard — Analytics

- [Overview](https://trycomly.com/audit): Brand Visibility score, AI Model Coverage (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity), competitor ranking table, visibility trend chart, and top AI response cards.
- [Prompts](https://trycomly.com/audit): Breakdown of all 25 audit prompts — per-model response, mention status, ranking position, and competitor co-mentions.
- [Sources](https://trycomly.com/audit): Domain-level citation analysis showing which websites AI models draw from when answering brand-related queries.

## Dashboard — Optimize

- [Reddit](https://trycomly.com/audit): Real-time matched Reddit threads where the brand's category and competitors are discussed. Includes AI-drafted reply suggestions and one-click engagement.
- [Quora](https://trycomly.com/audit): Matched Quora questions relevant to the brand's space. Includes AI-drafted answer suggestions and one-click engagement.
- [Brand Content](https://trycomly.com/audit): Content optimisation tools — Listicles, Comparison Pages, Hero Rewrite, and LLMs.txt generator — to improve how AI models describe the brand.

## Dashboard — Intelligence

- [Crawlers](https://trycomly.com/audit): Know exactly when AI crawls your website.
- [Competitor Playbook](https://trycomly.com/audit): See exactly why AI recommended your competition.

## Pricing

- [Pricing](https://trycomly.com/#pricing): Early Access plan at $99/month. No free tier. Includes unlimited audits, all dashboard features, and Reddit/Quora engagement tooling.
